compute_game_scores_from_state: compute game scores for a power from a Diplomacy game state dict with supply center counts
compute_game_scores: compute game scores for a power from the last phase of a full game JSON object
average_game_scores: average multiple GameScores tuples and return weighted averages with standard error estimates
compute_game_sos_from_state: compute square-of-supply-center scores for all powers from a Diplomacy game state dict
compute_game_dss_from_state: compute draw score shares for all alive powers from a Diplomacy game state dict
